projects.name: EarnKit
projects.one_liner: Grants and programs a builder's agent can apply to, pre-filled from the repo.

one_liner.text: EarnKit tells a builder's agent which grants the repo fits and fills the forms from it.
one_liner.short: Grants your agent can apply to, filled from your repo.

problem.text: Builders lose weeks finding grants they qualify for and rewriting the same answers for every form. Most never apply.
problem.short: Builders lose weeks on grant forms and most never apply.

solution.text: An MCP server the builder's agent calls from the repo: it reads the code, matches open programs and returns each form pre-filled, so the agent submits with one yes.
solution.short: An MCP server that matches the repo to programs and pre-fills each form.

milestones.text: Next three months: builder records shared across agents, program-side screening for two pilot programs, and 50 programs in the catalog.
milestones.short: Shared records, two screening pilots, 50 programs.

traction.line_pre_launch: Pre-launch: the agent tool is live and in private use; public launch in December 2026.

team.text: Jenil Thakker, solo founder, built tokens.fun and Coinvise before EarnKit.
